groups.problem: AccessTokenContext checks grantType twice instead of rejecting a null rawTokenId.
groups.rationale: All five identify the same incorrect requireNonNull argument in the constructor. Their differing descriptions of downstream consequences do not change the problem.

groups.problem: Unsupported token context causes encoding exceptions that abort token issuance instead of falling back.
groups.rationale: S13 reports the encoder's rejection behavior, while S4 reports its propagation through TokenManager.initToken. Both describe the same issuance failure and propose fallback handling.
